item.attuned.swift_focus.lore: Tuned to the wind's own hurry.
item.attuned.vital_focus.lore: A borrowed pulse, warm against the chest.
item.attuned.leap_focus.lore: Up is just another direction, properly asked.
item.attuned.edge_focus.lore: Sharper than the steel; the steel only follows.
item.attuned.frenzy_focus.lore: Strike again, before the first is done.
item.attuned.bulwark_focus.lore: Unmoved is its own kind of victory.
item.attuned.aegis_focus.lore: A held breath, made into armor.
item.attuned.nightgaze_focus.lore: The dark does not lift. You stop minding it.
item.attuned.delver_focus.lore: Stone remembers it was once dust.
item.attuned.thornward_focus.lore: To strike the attuned is to be answered.
item.attuned.attunement_shard.lore: Bind it close, and the soul makes a little more room.
